description: Behavior model inputs: frozen v1 flow statistics, ordered 32-packet timing/size sketch, protocol metadata and bounded host context. No IP, domain, ownership or reputation identifiers enter the vector.

features.name: flow_duration
features.calc: last_seen - first_seen
features.missing: 0 for a flow with a single packet

features.name: packets_forward
features.calc: packet count initiator->responder

features.name: packets_backward
features.calc: packet count responder->initiator

features.name: bytes_forward
features.calc: sum of IP datagram lengths forward (IP header included)

features.name: bytes_backward
features.calc: sum of IP datagram lengths backward (IP header included)

features.name: packet_size_mean
features.calc: mean total packet size over the flow

features.name: packet_size_min
features.calc: min total packet size

features.name: packet_size_max
features.calc: max total packet size

features.name: packet_size_stddev
features.calc: population stddev of packet size

features.name: forward_packet_size_mean
features.calc: mean packet size forward

features.name: backward_packet_size_mean
features.calc: mean packet size backward

features.name: packets_per_second
features.calc: total packets / max(flow_duration, 1e-6)

features.name: bytes_per_second
features.calc: total bytes / max(flow_duration, 1e-6)

features.name: forward_packets_per_second
features.calc: packets_forward / max(flow_duration, 1e-6)

features.name: backward_packets_per_second
features.calc: packets_backward / max(flow_duration, 1e-6)

features.name: interarrival_mean
features.calc: mean inter-arrival gap over all packets

features.name: interarrival_min
features.calc: min inter-arrival gap

features.name: interarrival_max
features.calc: max inter-arrival gap

features.name: interarrival_stddev
features.calc: population stddev of inter-arrival gaps

features.name: forward_interarrival_mean
features.calc: mean forward inter-arrival gap

features.name: backward_interarrival_mean
features.calc: mean backward inter-arrival gap

features.name: source_port
features.calc: initiator L4 port (0 for ICMP)

features.name: destination_port
features.calc: responder L4 port (0 for ICMP)

features.name: protocol_tcp
features.calc: 1 if transport is TCP

features.name: protocol_udp
features.calc: 1 if transport is UDP

features.name: protocol_icmp
features.calc: 1 if transport is ICMPv4/ICMPv6

features.name: tcp_syn_count
features.calc: packets with SYN set

features.name: tcp_ack_count
features.calc: packets with ACK set

features.name: tcp_fin_count
features.calc: packets with FIN set

features.name: tcp_rst_count
features.calc: packets with RST set

features.name: tcp_psh_count
features.calc: packets with PSH set

features.name: tcp_urg_count
features.calc: packets with URG set

features.name: syn_ack_ratio
features.calc: tcp_syn_count / max(tcp_ack_count, 1)

features.name: packet_direction_ratio
features.calc: packets_forward / max(total packets, 1)

features.name: byte_direction_ratio
features.calc: bytes_forward / max(total bytes, 1)

features.name: initial_tcp_window
features.calc: TCP window of the first forward segment

features.name: average_tcp_window
features.calc: mean advertised TCP window over the flow

features.name: down_up_bytes_ratio
features.calc: bytes_backward / max(bytes_forward, 1)

features.name: small_packet_ratio
features.calc: fraction of packets <= 100 bytes total

features.name: large_packet_ratio
features.calc: fraction of packets >= 1000 bytes total

features.name: average_payload_length
features.calc: mean L4 payload length over all packets

features.name: bidirectional_flag
features.calc: 1 if both directions carried >=1 packet

features.name: internal_to_internal
features.calc: 1 if both endpoints are RFC1918 / ULA / link-local

features.name: internal_to_external
features.calc: 1 if initiator internal, responder external

features.name: external_to_internal
features.calc: 1 if initiator external, responder internal

features.name: external_to_external
features.calc: 1 if neither endpoint is internal

features.name: dest_port_is_wellknown
features.calc: 1 if destination_port in [1, 1023]

features.name: snapshot_index
features.calc: nth periodic snapshot of a long-lived flow; 0 on close

features.name: timing_sample_fraction
features.calc: min(packet samples,32)/32

features.name: timing_gap_mean
features.calc: Mean of valid recent gaps

features.name: timing_gap_stddev
features.calc: Population standard deviation of valid recent gaps

features.name: timing_gap_cv
features.calc: Gap standard deviation / mean; zero if no positive mean

features.name: timing_lag1_correlation
features.calc: Pearson correlation of overlapping gap series offset 1; zero if insufficient/constant

features.name: timing_lag2_correlation
features.calc: Pearson correlation of overlapping gap series offset 2

features.name: timing_lag4_correlation
features.calc: Pearson correlation of overlapping gap series offset 4

features.name: timing_lag8_correlation
features.calc: Pearson correlation of overlapping gap series offset 8

features.name: timing_gap_median
features.calc: Median of valid recent gaps

features.name: timing_gap_p90
features.calc: Nearest-rank 90th percentile

features.name: timing_repeated_gap_ratio
features.calc: Adjacent gaps within 5 percent of mean; mean must be positive

features.name: timing_burst_ratio
features.calc: Share of gaps at most 10 milliseconds

features.name: timing_direction_switch_ratio
features.calc: Direction changes between adjacent recent samples

features.name: timing_forward_sample_ratio
features.calc: Positive size samples / sample count

features.name: payload_byte_fraction
features.calc: Flow L4 payload bytes / IP bytes

features.name: rich_telemetry_available
features.calc: 1 when rich packet telemetry is present

features.name: dns_queries
features.calc: DNS request packets observed in flow

features.name: dns_responses
features.calc: DNS response packets observed in flow

features.name: dns_nxdomain
features.calc: NXDOMAIN response packets observed in flow

features.name: dns_malformed
features.calc: Invalid complete DNS messages on port 53

features.name: dns_entropy_max
features.calc: Maximum leftmost query-label Shannon entropy

features.name: dns_entropy_mean
features.calc: Mean leftmost query-label Shannon entropy

features.name: dns_name_length_max
features.calc: Maximum observed query name length

features.name: dns_label_length_max
features.calc: Maximum query label length

features.name: dns_unique_names_sample
features.calc: Distinct flow query names retained, capped at 8

features.name: http_requests
features.calc: Complete single-packet HTTP request headers

features.name: suspicious_download_hints
features.calc: Executable extension or content-type indicators; not proof of malware

features.name: tls_client_hellos
features.calc: Complete single-packet TLS client hellos

features.name: irc_message_hints
features.calc: Observed plaintext IRC command prefixes

features.name: tls_sni_observed
features.calc: Server name seen in TLS client hello

features.name: http_host_observed
features.calc: Host name seen in HTTP request

features.name: application_metadata_available
features.calc: Fraction of captured packets whose IP length fit within the capture. Truncated packets are not interpreted as malformed application messages. Complete capture does not imply TLS decryption.

features.name: host_window_flows
features.calc: Up to 64 latest observed source-host conversations within 60 seconds

features.name: host_window_ports
features.calc: Distinct destination ports in host window

features.name: host_window_destinations
features.calc: Distinct destination addresses in host window; addresses themselves are never model inputs

features.name: host_window_syn_only_ratio
features.calc: Share with SYN and no ACK in host window

features.name: host_window_one_way_ratio
features.calc: Share with no responder packets

features.name: host_gap_mean
features.calc: Mean consecutive flow-start interval in bounded host window

features.name: host_gap_cv
features.calc: Population deviation / mean flow-start interval

features.name: host_gap_lag1
features.calc: Flow-start gap correlation offset 1

features.name: host_gap_lag2
features.calc: Flow-start gap correlation offset 2

features.name: host_window_dns_queries
features.calc: Cumulative query counts of retained distinct conversations

features.name: host_window_nxdomain
features.calc: Cumulative NXDOMAIN counts of retained distinct conversations

features.name: host_window_dns_names
features.calc: Distinct retained query-name hashes in host window

features.name: host_window_span
features.calc: Range of observed conversation starts within host window

features.name: host_window_bytes
features.calc: Sum cumulative bytes of retained distinct conversations

features.name: host_periodic_strength
features.calc: 1/(1+CV) if at least 8 inter-flow gaps and mean gap at least 5 seconds, else zero

features.name: host_context_available
features.calc: Host-window state was supplied by the pipeline
